summary.text: Brandun Schweizer has represented the 104th District in the Illinois House since December 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, he is a retired U.S. Marine Corps Master Sergeant who served 21 years and retired in January 2023.
After retiring from the Marine Corps he worked for the City of Danville as a Code Enforcement Officer, and he lives in Danville with his wife and three sons.
